```python
import logging
from DD4hepSimulation import DD4hepSimulation
from DD4hepSimulation import setOption, setOptions, run, import_geometry, importConstants, enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo
from DD4hepSimulation import setupTrackingField, EventAction, Gun, setupPhysics, PhysicsList, kernel, setupGun

def run_dd4hep_simulation():
    # Set up logging
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
    logger = logging.getLogger("DD4hepSimulation")
    logger.info("Starting DD4hep simulation setup.")

    # Import additional modules
    import DD4hepSimulation
    import DD4hepSimulation.Geant4 as Geant4

    # Set up the kernel
    sim = DD4hepSimulation()
    kernel_instance = kernel()

    # Load geometry from file
    geometry_file = "detector.xml"
    import_geometry(geometry_file)

    # Import constants
    importConstants("constants.xml")

    # Configure Geant4 interface
    setOption("Geant4Run", "UseUI", False)
    setOption("Geant4Run", "PrintLevel", 2)

    # Set up the tracking field
    setupTrackingField(field_type="Uniform", field_value=[0.0, 0.0, 2.0])

    # Set up event actions
    event_action = EventAction()
    setOption("EventAction", "PrintLevel", 1)

    # Set up the particle gun
    gun = Gun()
    setupGun(gun, particle="e-", energy=10.0, direction=[0,0,1])

    # Handle simulation particles
    setOption("ParticleHandler", "KeepAllParticles", True)

    # Build the physics list
    physics = PhysicsList()
    setupPhysics(physics, name="FTFP_BERT")

    # Enable detailed hits and particle info
    enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo(True)

    # Start the engine
    logger.info("Running the simulation.")
    run()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_dd4hep_simulation()
```
